text.style: font-family:'Times New Roman'; font-size:12pt; text-decoration:underline; color:#800000;

para.text: is within the range of the values at the eight corners all twelve edges are checked for possible cuts by the (hypothetical) surface by linear interpolation. The polygon creation routine is kept simple but should work well for all situations were the surface is not too heavily curved.
